description: Every scheduled data job (root ADR-0118, ADR-0122). What a job runs, as whom, with which environment and time limit is its systemd service in infra/systemd and nowhere else. This list adds when it runs, its resource pool, the pipeline-graph edges it carries out (its lineage, read from docs/catalog/pipeline-graph.v1.json) and whether Airflow runs it yet. A job that checks data rather than moving it names no edges and sets reads_data_contracts: its inputs are the tables the data contracts cover.

spark.description: The host's scheduled heavy work (root ADR-0138): FLOOR and lineage take all three slots (20g Spark) and run alone; a map-edit fold takes two, so the folds never overlap (their Spark runs share one init container name); the by-PNU bake takes one, so one fold can run beside it. The host memory guard checks every combination these slots allow.

pools_means: Every Airflow pool a job may name, besides Airflow's own default_pool, with its slot count; a job takes pool_slots of them (1 when absent). scripts/deploy/airflow-runtime.sh creates exactly these. orchestration/dags/job_specs.py refuses a job naming any other pool, a pool_slots above the pool's slots, and a job that could hold slots another job needs for longer than STARVATION_CYCLES runs of that job. scripts/guard/every-container-has-a-memory-cap.sh adds up the memory of every set of jobs the slots let run together (root ADR-0138). compose.orchestration.yml's AIRFLOW__CORE__PARALLELISM is at least the slots here plus one, so a default_pool job always has a slot (orchestration/tests/test_job_specs.py). A job's priority_weight decides which waiting job Airflow starts first when slots free (FLOOR and lineage above the folds, the folds above the bake). retries (1 when absent) is how often Airflow runs it again after a failure. A takes_turns job starts at most once between scheduled starts of every job in its pool that cannot run beside it: scripts/ops/start-scheduled-job.sh keeps the starts and defers it, so a multi-day bake cannot keep FLOOR and lineage waiting run after run.
enabled_means: Airflow starts the job's service on the schedule here; its systemd timer is gone from infra/systemd and the release retires it from the host (ADR-0122 §4). A job runs in exactly one of the two places.

jobs.description: 최신 complete Bronze FLOOR/title pair를 매일 재확인하고 FLOOR Silver 적재를 재시도한다. source_sweep의 신규 수집 건수와 독립적이다.
Daily source sweep: re-plan the provider list, skip files already held by fingerprint, land new ones in Bronze (root ADR-0077).
Outbox publish tick: deliver pending catalog events to their receivers (root ADR-0079).
Fold staff polygon edits into the administrative boundary tiles (root ADR-0112).
Fold staff polygon edits into the industrial complex tiles (root ADR-0112).
Parcel lineage stewardship cycle: fold steward decisions, rebuild and load the review queue (root ADR-0115).
Run the data contracts' executable checks (allowed values, schema) against the lakehouse and report each result to the data catalog (root ADR-0117 §6, ADR-0123).

Bake gold.parcel_panel, then gold.building_panel, into one R2 serving object per PNU and publish each lane's manifest (root ADR-0096, ADR-0100): a lane bakes only when Gold has a snapshot its published generation does not serve, objects create-only, a manifest moved only when the shards' exported rows add up to the Gold row count. The lanes run one after the other in one unit: side by side they would not fit the host memory budget (root ADR-0138).
jobs.disabled_reason: Replaces the hand-kept server script that baked this lane before 2026-10. Off until one supervised run of the repository job on the data host has baked and published a generation whose object count matched its Gold row count; switching it on is a separate deploy step (runbook docs/runbooks/parcel-by-pnu-serving-bake.md, 'Scheduled bake').

disabled_reason_means: A job may be listed before Airflow runs it: enabled false, no systemd timer, and disabled_reason says why it is off and what turns it on. The host refuses to start a job that is not enabled (scripts/ops/start-scheduled-job.sh), so a listed but disabled job runs nowhere until a deploy switches it on.
serving_surfaces_without_a_job_means: Every pipeline-graph serving surface whose surface_kind is r2_baked_documents or tiles is produced by a job in this list (a job edge ends at it), or is named here with the reason it has none yet. orchestration/tests/test_job_specs.py refuses a baked surface with neither, and an entry here that is stale (the surface has a job, or is not a baked surface).

serving_surfaces_without_a_job.reason: The national parcel tiles are rebaked from the lakehouse (root ADR-0133); that bake's job is registered with the ADR-0133 work, not here. Until then they are baked by hand per docs/runbooks/tiles-object-storage-first-slice.md.
